name: InnoScience (Suzhou) Technology Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: InnoScience (Suzhou) Technology Holding Co., Ltd., based in Suzhou and founded in 2015, researches, designs, manufactures and sells gallium nitride power semiconductors in China and abroad. Its offerings include GaN wafers, discrete chips, ICs and modules for consumer electronics, renewable energy, industrial and automotive electronics, and data centers.
